name: Pumpkin Custard
ingredients: 1 tsp cinnamon and ¼ tsp each nutmeg and ginger
steps: Whisk the cornflour into 3 tbsp of the soy milk to a smooth paste.
Heat the remaining soy milk with the pumpkin, spices and oil, stirring.
Add the cornflour paste and cook for 4–5 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Stir in the vanilla and pour into two bowls.
Chill for 1 hour and top with coconut.
note: Pumpkin is naturally sweet and low in glycaemic load when eaten with its fibre.
